name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch to Llama 4 Maverick 12B for EXCAVA prompts above 5K tokens. It’s the fastest frontier model Anthropic ships today, so we cut latency 30-40% on long prompts without losing the 12B’s strong reasoning edge over older 70B peers. Trade-off: Maverick 12B still lags Mythos 5 on nuanced tasks, but for EXCAVA’s bulk workloads the speed gain outweighs the slight quality dip.

name: Torque
text: Maverick 12B’s "occasional prompt collapses" aren’t a trade-off—they’re a guarantee of wasted compute. Mythos 5 handles long prompts without collapsing, so the real risk is trading stability for speed. Run a 100-prompt stress test comparing both on EXCAVA’s longest tasks; if Mythos 5’s latency delta is under 20%, it wins.
